steps.message:
There's a Next.js e-commerce app at `/app`. Users experience visual instability issues including layout shifts and generally a bad experience.

Your job is to assess the root cause of the user experience issues by using best practices in nexts and react and fix accordingly.

## Rules

- Don't break existing functionality
- Don't change existing class names, ids or data-testid on any of the components as tests rely on them

I'll help you assess and fix the visual instability issues in this Next.js e-commerce app. Let me start by exploring the codebase to understand the structure and identify potential causes of layout shifts and poor UX.

steps.message: Perfect! I've successfully fixed all the visual instability issues in your Next.js e-commerce app. The build completed without errors. Here's a summary of all the improvements made: ## Issues Fixed: ### 1. **Image Optimization** (`src/components/ProductCard.tsx`) - **Problem**: Used regular `` tag without dimensions, causing layout shifts when images loaded - **Solution**: - Migrated to Next.js `Image` component with `fill` prop - Added fixed height container (`h-48`) matching the skeleton - Added `object-cover` and `sizes` attribute for proper responsive images - This prevents Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) by reserving space before image loads ### 2. **Skeleton Loading States** (`src/components/ProductList.tsx`) - **Problem**: Showed only "Loading products..." text, causing layout shifts when products appeared - **Solution**: - Render 15 skeleton placeholders during loading - Matches the exact structure of actual product cards - Maintains consistent grid layout ### 3. **Font Loading Optimization** (`src/app/globals.css`) - **Problem**: Custom font loaded without `font-display` strategy, causing Flash of Invisible Text (FOIT) - **Solution**: Added `font-display: swap` to `@font-face` rule - Shows fallback font immediately, swaps to custom font when loaded ### 4. **Theme Flash Prevention** (`src/app/layout.tsx`) - **Problem**: Theme loaded from localStorage after React hydration, causing flash of incorrect theme - **Solution**: - Added inline script in `` that runs before React loads - Reads theme from localStorage immediately and sets `data-theme` attribute - Prevents visual flash during theme initialization ### 5. **Async Component Layout Shifts** (Banner, LateBanner, SidePane, ResultsBar) - **Problem**: Components conditionally rendered after API calls, causing major layout shifts when they appeared - **Solution**: - **Banner**: Always renders with "Loading..." placeholder - **LateBanner**: Always renders with "Loading..." placeholder - **SidePane**: Always renders with loading placeholders for categories/filters - **ResultsBar**: Always renders when products exist, uses opacity for visibility control - All components now maintain their layout space from the start ## Impact: - ✅ Eliminated Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) from images - ✅ Prevented layout jumps during async content loading - ✅ Fixed font loading Flash of Invisible Text - ✅ Prevented theme flash on initial load - ✅ Improved loading states with proper skeletons - ✅ All existing functionality preserved (no class/id/testid changes) The app should now provide a much more stable and professional user experience with no unexpected layout shifts!
